title: Map the iHRIS 4 logical models to the three iHRIS 5 IGs (F4)
description: Compiles the three iHRIS 5 IGs (ig/, ihris-backend-site/ig, qualify-ig) from the pinned, mounted source with SUSHI 3.20.1 in .build/ihris5-sd/, and indexes what compiles (names, element paths, labels, types, bindings, Questionnaire item texts, each file's sha256) into src/ihris-4-on-fhir/mapping/ihris5-index.json. Then matches each logical model to a profile per IG and its elements to the profile's elements by name and label equality only (tiers exact, accepted, ambiguous, none; an owner-accepted proposal in authored/ decides a model or element, a rejected one removes its candidates), and writes crosswalk.json, the two-way gap report (gaps.json, gaps.md) and one StructureMap per mapped model and IG as FSH Instances in input/fsh/maps/, built by gen_fsh.py's SUSHI run. --check: the crosswalk, gap report and StructureMaps are current against the committed index (no iHRIS 5 mount needed, so CI runs it). --propose (by hand, never in a build): ADDS proposal items for ambiguous matches and the bean's examples to src/ihris-data-dictionary/authored/ihris5-mapping.json, never changing an existing item.

inputs.name: ihris5Source
inputs.description: Read from ihris5-source/ when it is mounted at the pin; never written

inputs.name: authoredProposals
inputs.description: The owner's accepted and rejected mapping decisions, read from src/ihris-data-dictionary/authored/
